title: On the relations between several notions of symmetry for the second order linear differential equation
summary: There are several non-equivalent notions of infinitesimal symmetry in the literature of second order linear differential equations: Lie point symmetries, vertical (gauge) symmetries, operator symmetries, infinitesimal contact symmetries, and Lie--Bäcklund operators. We construct an explicit correspondence among the first three, We then describe the Lie algebra $\mathcal L_Ω(\mathbb U)$ of infinitesimal contact transformations of the contact system $Ω=\langle dy-y'\,dx\rangle$, with coefficients in a differential field $\U$ of functions of $x$ and $y$.
